014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.lang.constant.Constable;
017import java.lang.constant.DynamicConstantDesc;
018import java.lang.constant.MethodHandleDesc;
019
020import java.util.List;
021import java.util.Objects;
022import java.util.Optional;
023
024import org.microbean.constant.Constables;
025
026import org.microbean.qualifier.NamedAttributeMap;
027
028import org.microbean.scope.ScopeMember;
029
030import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.BSM_INVOKE;
031import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_boolean;
032import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_int;
033import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_List;
034import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.FALSE;
035import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.TRUE;
036
037import static org.microbean.bean.ConstantDescs.CD_Id;
038import static org.microbean.bean.ConstantDescs.CD_BeanTypeList;
039
040import static org.microbean.qualifier.ConstantDescs.CD_NamedAttributeMap;
041
042public final record Id(BeanTypeList types,
043                       List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes,
044                       NamedAttributeMap<?> governingScopeId,
045                       boolean alternate,
046                       int rank)
047  implements Constable, Ranked, ScopeMember {
048
049  public Id(final BeanTypeList types,
050            final List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes,
051            final NamedAttributeMap<?> governingScopeId) {
052    this(types, attributes, governingScopeId, false, Ranked.DEFAULT_RANK);
053  }
054
055  public Id(final BeanTypeList types,
056            final List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes,
057            final NamedAttributeMap<?> governingScopeId,
058            final int rank) {
059    this(types, attributes, governingScopeId, false, rank);
060  }
061
062  public Id {
063    Objects.requireNonNull(types, "types");
064    attributes = List.copyOf(attributes);
065    Objects.requireNonNull(governingScopeId, "governingScopeId");
066  }
067
068  @Override // Constable
069  public final Optional<DynamicConstantDesc<Id>> describeConstable() {
070    return Constables.describeConstable(this.attributes())
071      .flatMap(attributesDesc -> this.governingScopeId().describeConstable()
072               .flatMap(governingScopeIdDesc -> types.describeConstable()
073                        .map(typesDesc -> DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE,
074                                                                 MethodHandleDesc.ofConstructor(CD_Id,
075                                                                                                CD_BeanTypeList,
076                                                                                                CD_List,
077                                                                                                CD_NamedAttributeMap,
078                                                                                                CD_boolean,
079                                                                                                CD_int),
080                                                                 typesDesc,
081                                                                 attributesDesc,
082                                                                 governingScopeIdDesc,
083                                                                 this.alternate() ? TRUE : FALSE,
084                                                                 this.rank()))));
085  }
086
087}
